title: 2026上海马拉松参赛攻略已送达
publisher: 上海体育（上海市体育局官方账号，腾讯新闻转载）
claims: The 2026 Shanghai Marathon uses six gun starts: 06:45 wheelchair, 07:00 elite/pre-elite/A, 07:04 B, 07:10 C, 07:19 D and 07:26 E.

Start corral access points are: A at Hankou Road/Henan Middle Road, B at Jiujiang Road/Henan Middle Road, C via Nanjing East Road/Henan Middle Road then Jiangxi Middle Road and Dianchi Road, D at Beijing East Road/Henan Middle Road, and E at Henan Middle Road/Suzhou South Road.

Bag trucks are assigned by corral: A1-A3 on Hankou Road, B1-B5 on Jiujiang Road, C1-C7 on Dianchi Road, D1-D6 on Beijing East Road and E1-E8 on Suzhou South Road; bag drop closes at 06:45 and runners are advised to enter the check area before 06:30.

Drink/water stations run every 5 km from 5 km; water/sponge stations run every 5 km from 7.5 km. Energy supplies are bananas at 12.5, 15, 32.5 and 37.5 km, small cakes at 17.5 and 35 km, SiS gels at 25 km and chocolate at 27.5 and 40 km.

After the finish, runners enter Shanghai Stadium through Passage 4 for the medal and finish bag, pass the sponsor area and exit through Passage 1; bag tents A1-A3 and B1-B2 exit via Xujiahui Sports Park Gate 1, while B3-B5, C1-C7, D1-D6 and E1-E8 exit via Gate 2 towards Metro Lines 1 and 4 at Shanghai Indoor Stadium.
The official guide forecasts light rain and 10-15 C for race day, while noting that the latest forecast prevails.
Runners in corrals A-D are advised to take Metro Lines 2 or 10 to Nanjing East Road and walk 10-15 minutes; corral E runners are advised to take Lines 10 or 12 to Tiantou Road, with a longer walk.
